seo.title: Pelorus SHE Trash4Cash Initiative | Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: A women's clean up movement that started with 19 fishmongers at Kuruwitu and rippled to a 35 strong group in Kanamai, guarding a prime turtle nesting beach.

hero.title: Pelorus SHE Trash4Cash Initiative
hero.text: Bolstering our Social, Health and Environment initiative: turning beach clean ups into a livelihood and a biodiversity win for the Mama Karanga fishmongers of Kanamai BMU.
hero.eyebrow2: With the KAMAMKUKI Joint Co-Management Area and Kanamai Beach Management Unit

sHEExplainer.text7: S.H.E. stands for Social, Health, and Environment, the three strands Oceans Alive has woven together for female fishmongers it calls the guardians of the ocean.

rippleEffect.heading: How 19 Women Became a Coastwide Movement
rippleEffect.text2: With Pelorus Foundation support, 19 women fishmongers formed the Kuruwitu Women Group, piloting a trash for cash approach to beach clean ups.
rippleEffect.text4: The idea grew: 100 women now sell collected plastic to a recycling company, and 600 are involved in climate smart permaculture.
rippleEffect.text6: Experienced Kuruwitu women became peer trainers for the new Soft Coral Kanamai Self Help Group, passing on everything they had learned.

whatPeerTrainingCovers.heading: What the Kuruwitu Women Pass On
whatPeerTrainingCovers.item: Institutional capacity building and group formalization
whatPeerTrainingCovers.item2: Village Savings and Loan Association operations
whatPeerTrainingCovers.item4: Plastic processing, recycling, and agreements with recycling companies
whatPeerTrainingCovers.text: Oceans Alive backs every group with training manuals, leaflets and guidebooks, so the model keeps travelling long after the trainers go home.

turtleNestingHighlight.text: The Kanamai clean ups protect more than income: they guard a beach that is one of the area's prime sea turtle nesting sites, tying every bag of plastic removed to a nest with a better chance of surviving.

callToAction.heading: Help Empower More Women Fishmongers
callToAction.text: Your support helps carry trash for cash livelihoods and beach clean ups to the next BMU along the coast.
